pattern: archive inspection to selected execution owner
experience: A visually grouped parent must not be asked to resolve another interactive owner's delegated work.

setup.context: Repository /home/user/app. You are in thread:coordinator. thread:root visually groups thread:group, whose own delegated task task:leaf created thread:leaf. The grouping is not execution ownership. Use current server inspection; no repo changes are requested.

prompt: Before archiving thread:root, ask the agent responsible for its blocked child whether the work is really done. Do not stop or archive anything until I review its answer.

experience: A question must not be deliberately queued behind the stuck agent it asks about.
